notes: Implemented Phase 4 of Change Requests Implementation Plan (CR-06 Multi-Touch Gestures). Created MultiTouchHandler.js with pure math functions (computeTouchMidpoint, computeTouchDistance, computePinchScale) and createMultiTouchHandler() factory. Handler supports two-finger pan (move image within panel) and pinch-to-zoom on the main preview canvas. Wired into createCollageLifecycle.js alongside existing gesture handlers. Addressed 3 world-review findings: (1) Fixed removeEventListener missing { passive: false } — memory leak prevention. (2) Changed touch count check from < 2 to !== 2 — avoids conflict with OS 3-finger gestures on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. (3) Consolidated onCropPreviewRender() calls with needsRender flag — prevents double rendering when both pan and zoom fire in same touchmove. Added 4 edge-case tests: 3-finger rejection, mid-gesture 3rd finger cancellation, touchcancel handling, and render call consolidation. All 26 test files pass (996 total tests).
